The 'H1 rejection disappears once spanning individuals are excluded' sentence must be withdrawn and rewritten; the apparent disappearance was the greedy convention suppressing the H1 signal. This is a User-facing prose direction change on a claim in a section already drafted — escalate rather than rewrite.

Under 'now_rejects' both metrics agree and the disappearance claim dies outright. Under 'still_non_rejects' the two metrics disagree and section 6.2 must report the disagreement, per CONVENTIONS: no H1 conclusion rests on W2 alone.

C_markov2.reproduces_exact: If a fresh exact re-derivation reproduces the stored Markov-2 values within tolerance -> exact-era CONFIRMED by artifact; P01-B section 4.2's Markov-2 rows become citable and lose the 'ungated' annotation.

DO NOT infer the verdict from the file's date or from a dependency pin: a lockfile dates when something became guaranteed, never when it became present. entries.gated_on: Phase 1 complete AND a measured cost model accepted by the Manager. Phase 2 is a PRODUCTION RE-RUN, not a cache re-derivation: every Table 1 source (L5000_postaudit_2026-05-02, L2000_legacy_2026-04-07, L5000_markov2_postaudit_2026-05-02, stratified_markov1_L5000_2026-05-02) pre-dates the earliest null cache (2026-05-24), so null diagrams must be regenerated under frozen loadings before any W2 is computed.
entries.scope: H1 rows only. H0 rows stand (greedy is provably identical to optimal transport at zero births) and MUST NOT be recomputed or altered.

negative_controls.statement: The label-shuffle, cohort-shuffle and order-shuffle rows are the paper's NEGATIVE CONTROLS. Under the greedy convention a negative control could not fail — greedy inflates obs-null and null-null together — so these have never actually been tested. This rebuild is the first real test.
negative_controls.control_holds: Negative-control H1 fails to reject (p >= 0.05) -> the control PASSES and P01-A section 4.3's negative-control claim stands, now on tested rather than assumed evidence. Report as a strengthened claim.
negative_controls.control_fails: Negative-control H1 REJECTS (p < 0.05) -> the negative control FAILS. This is a major adverse finding: the pipeline detects structure in data whose structure has been destroyed. STOP the phase, do not proceed to prose, escalate to the Manager and User immediately with the cell, the diagram-bound screen, and the null construction. Do not rationalise it as a landmark or size artefact without a dedicated test.

markov_rows.consistent: Markov-1 H1 rejects on both datasets, consistent in direction with the corrected exact headlines -> Table 1 H1 column is rebuilt and citable; the 'do not cite any Table 1 H1 row' block in SUPERSEDED.md is lifted for the rebuilt rows only.
markov_rows.inconsistent: Any rebuilt Markov-1 H1 cell disagrees in DIRECTION with the corrected exact headline for the same dataset -> STOP and escalate. Two independent exact computations of the same object disagreeing is a defect in one of them, not a finding.

decision_rule.prose_direction: Table 1's H1 column may be cited in P01-A only after this phase completes and its rows pass the diagonal-bound screen. Until then the standing instruction (SUPERSEDED.md: 'Do not cite any Table 1 H1 row') remains in force. No prose Task may consume phase-2 numbers before the Manager files the post-run [RESULT] and, where an outcome fork fires, the outcome-lock [DECISION].

stop_rules.wall_time: Projected wall time > 12 h at the chosen worker count -> STOP and escalate before launching. Do not launch and monitor.
stop_rules.cost_model_divergence: Measured per-unit cost diverges from any inherited memo figure by > 2x -> record the measurement in the result JSON and re-project before launching.

planned_contracts.rationale: A result file from a solver with a silent approximate fallback must record the solver identity and exactness in-band, or a reader cannot distinguish an exact result from a greedy one. The committed headline JSONs recorded pvalue_formula, L, B, seed and frozen_loadings but NOT the solver — which is why a greedy artifact gated P01-B prose for weeks.

planned_contracts.rationale: Obs 58's impossibility bound, mechanised. W2(A,B) <= sqrt(diag_norm_sq(A) + diag_norm_sq(B)) because projecting every point of both diagrams to the diagonal is always an admissible matching. A reported value above this bound is provably not a Wasserstein distance. The committed USoc H1 headline 233.68 sat ~6.5x above its ~35.8 bound and no check caught it for weeks.
planned_contracts.claim: Every exact W2 value written by this Task satisfies value <= diagonal_bound(dgm_a, dgm_b) + tol. A violation aborts the write.
planned_contracts.must_exclude_degenerate: The screen must be applied to every reported exact distance, not a sample, and its per-cell results recorded in-band under diagonal_bound_screen.

planned_contracts.rationale: Obs 60. The 2026-07-12 run's 'sanity cross-check' compared committed_orphan_stats against the committed JSON those values had been COPIED FROM in the prior step — it compared the committed values against themselves, passed unconditionally, and its vacuous PASS carried the memo's entire wrong conclusion. A gate that can only pass is not a gate.
planned_contracts.claim: For every committed value this Task re-derives, the convention gate puts a FRESHLY RECOMPUTED number on at least one side of the comparison. Specifically: (a) the greedy replica, run over the cache through the fresh code path, reproduces the committed value within tol — establishing convention identity; AND (b) the exact value is computed fresh from the same cache, never read from any committed artifact. A gate whose reference side is copied from the artifact under test FAILS.
planned_contracts.counter_example_history: 2026-07-12 WT-1: 05_assemble_result.py compared usoc_w2_data['committed_orphan_stats'] to the committed headline JSON; the field had been copied verbatim from that same JSON by 03_..._w2_headline.py. PASS was trivially true. Re-deriving through the fresh path would have produced ~12.4 exact vs the committed 233.68 and exposed the greedy gap immediately.
